# gigahost_bgp (Data Source)

Returns all ASNs and BGP sessions for the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gigahost_bgp" "example" {}

output "asns" {
  value = data.gigahost_bgp.example.asns
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `asns` (Attributes List) Autonomous system numbers registered on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asns))
- `sessions` (Attributes List) BGP sessions configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))

<a id="nestedatt--asns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asns`

Read-Only:

- `asn` (String) Autonomous system number.
- `country` (String) Country the ASN is registered in.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `name` (String) ASN name as registered.
- `status` (String) Approval status of the ASN.


<a id="nestedatt--sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sessions`

Read-Only:

- `asn_id` (String) Internal ID of the ASN record.
- `default_route` (Boolean) True when the session receives the default route.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address the session peers from.
- `ip_type` (String) Address family of the peering address.
- `neighbor_ipv4` (String) IPv4 address of the BGP neighbour.
- `neighbor_ipv6` (String) IPv6 address of the BGP neighbour.
- `status` (String) Approval status of the ASN.
